project_lysandra_summary: An adventure game in a sky of floating islands, with a playable demo.
project_lysandra_picture_1: Provisional illustration: a figure seen from behind on a hill looks at a floating island.
project_lysandra_picture_2: Provisional illustration: a stone arch and a waterfall at the edge of a floating island.
project_huzounet_summary: The reference site for players of Dofus online: items, monsters, market and tools.
project_huzounet_picture_home: The huzounet.fr home page, “La Référence du Mode Online”, over a glowing Dofus egg.
project_huzounet_picture_equipments: The huzounet.fr equipment list: builds by element, filtered by mode, level, budget and class.
project_huzounet_picture_market: The huzounet.fr market: price, profit and crafting return of each item on the chosen server.
project_huzounet_picture_mobile: huzounet.fr on mobile: the home page and the equipment list.
project_atelier_summary: A visual scripting core for Unity: assemble gameplay in the Inspector or in C#.
project_atelier_picture_behaviour: An Atelier behaviour in the Unity Inspector: when E is pressed, if the object is active, it is deactivated.
project_atelier_picture_node_picker: Atelier's instruction picker, sorted by category (Audio, Cameras, Characters…), open over a behaviour.
project_atelier_picture_custom_node: A condition written in C#, “Is On Screen”, added in the Inspector next to the built-in “Is Active” condition.
